canon: La capital de verdad: piedra maciza, un salón de consejo lo bastante grande para reunir a súbditos y visitantes de varios asentamientos a la vez, y refuerzos de mena de hierro en los puntos de carga. Materiales: bloques de piedra tallada, lingotes de hierro, vigas de madera tallada, columnas de hueso, cordaje trenzado y resina. Construcción orca (constructor-orcos-llanuras).
propuestas: sin banner: sigue la temática de la choza básica de los orcos de las Llanuras (usuaria, 2026-11-09): huesos curvos de gargantúa atados, pieles cosidas, marca del clan; se empieza por el grande y se baja al mediano y al pequeño (usuaria: «de más a menos»)
costillar de huesos gigantes como techo y casas de hueso alrededor: diseño de imagen, no canon

capas.notas: IMG-54, plantilla por capas (scripts/capas.py): forma sin color en los campos de lápiz; color, paleta y luz solo en el paso a foto. Temática de la choza (choza-basica-orco-llanuras, banner); de más a menos: grande primero. Del estudio: «stacked stones» da ladrillo; la luz de dentro se pinta en la puerta salvo que el interior esté oscuro.
capas.sujeto: The great council hall of a tusked steppe people, the seat of their capital, standing on a low rise above a desert plain, seen from a low camera angle three-quarters from the front, filling the image from the bottom edge to near the top and most of its width.
capas.tamano: It is huge: a long massive hall as tall as ten men and about four times as wide as it is tall, with tiny figures of people at its entrance for scale.
capas.forma: Its walls are huge irregular blocks of rough stone, each as tall as a man, fitted like a megalithic wall. Over them rises a great curved roof held on a row of huge arching bones of giant beasts, like the ribs of a whale, lashed at every crossing with thick braided cords and capped with plates of hammered iron where they rest on the stone. Sewn hides are stretched tight between the ribs as the roof. Thick columns of bound bones and carved timber beams frame a tall, wide entrance, one column carved with a bold clan mark; the doorway itself is an empty hollow in deep shadow; far inside, at the back of the hall and away from the door, a great fire glows small and distant, and smoke rises from vents along the roof ridge.
capas.entorno: Around it, smaller domed huts of bone and hide and the tents of the settlement spread across the plain, with a wide beaten path leading up to the entrance; jagged rock pinnacles rise to the left and flat-topped mesas fade into haze on the far horizon under a wide sky of broken clouds.
capas.color: The cut stone is red ochre, weathered and dusty; the bones are pale and weathered, cracked and dirty; the braided cords dark brown; the iron plates dark and streaked with rust; the hides patched red-brown and tan. The clan mark is black. The glow deep inside is warm orange. The ground and the far mesas are red, the sky broken golden cloud.
capas.paleta: rust red, bone white and golden ochre
capas.luz: Warm, hazy golden light falls from high on the right, picking out the curve of the bones and the stitched seams, with a soft shadow to the left of the hall.
